name: card-drift
title: Card Drift
description: Draggable card grid with physics-based throw, velocity tracking, auto-layout, and GSAP Draggable

changelog.summary: Stopped rebuilding the random card layout when remixer values change; rotation now updates individual cards only.

Removed data/cards and shadowOpacity from the public prop surface, replaced Tailwind color class props with color-picker props, and added working driftAmount, rotationAmount, smoothness, and lerp controls.

Added data, bgColor, bgTextColor, cardBg, cardTextColor, and barBg as public props with a working remixer panel. The originally suggested props (driftAmount, rotationAmount, duration, shadowOpacity) described ambient hover drift, but this component is a drag-and-throw physics grid with fixed jitter/rotation constants, so they were replaced with the content/theme props CardDriftComp actually accepts.
Added a prefers-reduced-motion notice explaining that dragging stays fully interactive since it is a direct, user-initiated action.

props.name: backgroundColor
props.description: Background color for the draggable card field.

props.name: backgroundTextColor
props.description: Color of the large background label.

props.name: cardColor
props.description: Background color for each draggable card.

props.name: cardTextColor
props.description: Text color for each draggable card.

props.name: barColor
props.description: Background color for each card's tag bar.

props.name: driftAmount
props.description: Initial scatter and drag throw distance for cards.

props.name: rotationAmount
props.description: Maximum random rotation applied to individual cards.

props.name: smoothness
props.description: Release and scale smoothing duration for each dragged card.

props.name: lerp
props.description: Velocity smoothing amount while dragging; higher values react faster.
